securityInfo.accessBody: Finkison uses role-based accounts. School access follows assigned account roles and school arrangements. A parent or guardian must link a learner before seeing learner-specific information.
securityInfo.sessionsBody: The versioned API uses short-lived access tokens and rotating refresh tokens. Refresh tokens are stored in HttpOnly, SameSite cookies.
securityInfo.schoolBody: School administrators can review active account sessions and available audit activity from their security settings.
securityInfo.aiBody: Questions sent to AI-supported tools are processed to generate a response. Avoid including sensitive personal information in a prompt.
securityInfo.contactBody: Contact our team for information about security and data practices relevant to your account or school.

privacyInfo.intro: This overview describes the main information Finkison uses. Students should not enter sensitive personal information into AI prompts. School-managed accounts may have additional arrangements; ask your school contact how they apply to you.
privacyInfo.accountBody: Information can include your name, email address, phone number, account role, grade, school, and details you send through the contact form.
privacyInfo.learningBody: Finkison records learning and assessment activity needed to provide lessons, practice, results, study tools, and progress views available to your account.
privacyInfo.aiBody: When you use an AI tutor or related tool, the question and context you submit are processed to generate a response. Some tutor requests are sent to Google's Gemini service. Do not include sensitive personal information in a prompt.
privacyInfo.accessBody: School access depends on assigned account roles and school arrangements. A parent or guardian must link a learner account before seeing learner-specific information.
privacyInfo.browserBody: The site saves preferences such as language, display theme, and dismissed notices in your browser. Sign-in sessions are also stored in browser storage so you can stay signed in.
privacyInfo.useBody: We use account, learning, and contact information to provide the features you use, support school workflows, respond to enquiries, and protect the service.
privacyInfo.retentionBody: Account and learning records are kept so the service and school workflows can operate. Retention and deletion can depend on school account arrangements. Ask your school contact or contact Finkison to confirm what applies.
privacyInfo.requestsBody: Contact us about access, correction, or deletion requests. Include the account email and school name where relevant so the request can be routed correctly.

termsInfo.intro: This page summarizes the main expectations for using Finkison. It does not replace a separate written agreement that may apply to school-managed access.
termsInfo.useBody: Available features depend on your account and school arrangements. They may include curriculum materials, practice, assessments, AI-supported study tools, and school workflows.
termsInfo.accountBody: Use your own account, keep sign-in details private, and provide accurate information. Contact support if you think someone else has accessed your account.
termsInfo.pricingBody: School plans are Essentials at ETB 250, Growth at ETB 350, and Complete at ETB 500 per student each month. A 12-month term uses the published monthly rate for 12 months. School setup, payment, and activation are arranged directly with Finkison. Individual student subscriptions are separate personal purchases.
termsInfo.resultsBody: AI responses and practice results are learning support. Review important information with your teacher or curriculum materials. Practice results do not guarantee exam scores, admission, or other outcomes.
